{{About|the advancements in Matcha Flavoured|the fish catalog|Angler's Almanac}}
'''Advancements''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] replace the whole vanilla advancement tree. They guide the player through the pack's [[progression]], reward [[obol]]s and [[Crystal Heart|crystal hearts]], and, for seven milestones, lower the player's minimum [[health]]. The pack also uses several hundred hidden advancements internally, to trigger mechanics and unlock recipes.

When the pack loads, it tells players: "If you get lost or confused, check the advancements".<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> The README gives the same advice to players stuck in the early game.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref>

== Overview ==
The datapack blocks the five vanilla advancement folders (<code>story</code>, <code>nether</code>, <code>end</code>, <code>adventure</code> and <code>husbandry</code>) through the filter in its <code>pack.mcmeta</code>, so none of the vanilla advancements exist.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> The pack's own advancements are in the <code>matcha</code> namespace, in four visible tabs:

{{Data/Advancements/tabs
|matcha:tutorial/root=Joining the world
|matcha:hell/root=Entering [[Hell]]
|matcha:end/root=Entering [[the End]]
|matcha:anglers_almanac/root=Obtaining the [[Angler's Almanac]]
}}

=== Rewards ===
Many advancements give a reward, and their descriptions show it as a symbol before the text:
* {{G|E00F}} Each coin symbol is one [[obol]], given as an item. Larger rewards are written as a number, such as "10 {{G|E00F}}".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/advancement/obol_1.json}}</ref>
* ❤ Each heart symbol is one [[Crystal Heart|crystal heart]], given as an item. Only the four "Canto" advancements give hearts.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/advancement/crystal_heart_1.json}}</ref>
* {{G|E010}} The broken heart symbol marks a milestone that lowers the player's '''minimum hearts''' by 1. Each player's minimum starts at 10 hearts and is the lowest their maximum health can fall through [[death]]. Seven milestones carry this symbol, so completing all of them lowers the minimum to 3 hearts, the floor for Hard. On Easy the minimum is always 10 hearts. On Normal, a player whose minimum falls below 6 hearts, which happens at the fifth milestone, switches the world to Hard. Each step prints an ominous message in chat, such as "The Dead grow restless...".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/heart_container/decrease_minimum_hearts.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/scoreboard/create_scoreboards.mcfunction}}</ref>

The broken-heart milestones are Brazier (copper), The Stalwart Metal (iron), The Resilient Mineral (diamond), A Zealous Alloy (electrum), A Divine Alloy (adamant), Orpheus (entering Hell) and The End of Dreams (finding a stronghold). The system rewards slow progress: a player who rushes for iron and diamonds makes their deaths more costly sooner. See [[Death]] and [[Difficulty]].

=== Revocation on update ===
When a player joins a world after it has been updated to a newer version of the pack, their recipe unlocks are reset, along with most advancements that give rewards or affect the heart system, so that they can be earned again under the new rules, and the player's minimum hearts reset to 10.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/update_this_player.mcfunction}}</ref> In 1.12.2-beta this revokes:
* in the Tutorial tab, "Prometheus be Damned" and everything after it (the whole metal and cooking progression, including all seven broken-heart milestones), "Hellish Powder" and everything after it (including the Canto advancements), and the chain from "From Earth" through "You're Rich!", "Bonfire Lit", "A Good Samaritan" and "Fishmonger" to "A True Community";
* in the Hell tab, everything except "Hidden in the Depths" and "Demonic Emissary";
* in the End tab, "Wax Wings", "Icarus' Folly" and "Wings of Eros".

"No More Fish in the Sea", "God help you...", "Demonic Emissary", "Hidden in the Depths", "To Dreams" and "Iconoclast" are kept; the code notes that the fishing and prayer advancements are spared deliberately. Because "From Earth" is revoked, it is granted again on the next tick and reruns the pack's first-load setup, including the game rules. See [[Updating items]].

The <code>main</code> branch replaces the tutorial part with a hand-picked, narrower list, so in the next version "Prometheus be Damned" and much of the early progression will be kept: the kiln, oven and blast furnace advancements, most of the metal and alloy advancements, and the Brazier, The Stalwart Metal and The Resilient Mineral milestones. The Stalwart Metal is kept only because the list names <code>matcha:tutorial/obtain_iron</code>, which doesn't exist (the advancement is <code>obtain_iron_ingot</code>).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/update_this_player.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Tutorial ==
{{See also|Progression|Guide for new players}}
The Tutorial tab, rooted in "From Earth", traces the pack's progression in several branches: the fire, kiln and metal line that ends with alloys and smithing; a cooking line; a warding and jewelry line; the four "Canto" gem hunts; and a trading and fishing line. "From Earth" is granted on the first tick a player is in the world and runs the pack's first-load setup.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/root.json}}</ref> The requirements below are the actual criteria in the code, which are sometimes broader than the in-game description.

== Hell ==
The Hell tab appears when the player first enters [[Hell]]. Its main line follows the pack's magic: [[Benzene|benzene]], [[Stabilized Estus|stabilized Estus]], and then either a [[Warding Stone|warding stone]] or the [[Hell-Bound Book|hell-bound book]] used to craft [[blessing]]s.

{{Data/Advancements/hell
|matcha:hell/root=Enter Hell.
|matcha:hell/obtain_benzene=Have [[Benzene|benzene]] in the inventory.
|matcha:hell/obtain_stabilised_estus=Craft [[Stabilized Estus|stabilized Estus]].
|matcha:hell/craft_hell_bound_book=Craft a [[Hell-Bound Book|hell-bound book]].
|matcha:hell/craft_blessing=Craft any of 17 [[blessing]]s.
|matcha:hell/steal_all_prayers=Craft all 23 blessing recipes and the hell-bound book.
|matcha:hell/obtain_warding_stone=Craft a [[Warding Stone|warding stone]].
|matcha:hell/obtain_ancient_debris=Have ancient debris or [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]] in the inventory.
}}

The End tab appears when the player first enters [[the End]].

{{Data/Advancements/end
|matcha:end/root=Enter the End.
|matcha:end/kill_dragon=Kill the [[Ender Dragon]].
|matcha:end/kill_dragon reward={{#tag:ref|The reward function drops a divine favor at 0, 100, 0 in the End, announces "Evil has been banished from the surface." to every player, and turns on the safe-surface rule that stops hostile mobs spawning on the overworld surface. }}

== Angler's Almanac ==
{{Main|Angler's Almanac}}
The Angler's Almanac tab is a catalog of catches, added by imtlx in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]]. Its root can never be completed by play. Obtaining the [[Angler's Almanac]] item runs a function that unlocks it, and every entry requires the root.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/anglers_almanac/get_almanac.json}}</ref> Each entry is hidden until the player hooks the matching item with a fishing rod, and its description gives the catch's rarity in stars. No entry gives a reward. In 1.12.2-beta the Hot Saltwater pufferfish entry can't be unlocked, because it checks for the model <code>matcha:pufferfish</code> while caught pufferfish keep the vanilla model.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/anglers_almanac/saltwater/hot/pufferfish.json}}</ref>

|-
| Saltwater || Cold, cool, temperate, warm, hot || 25 (5 each)
|-

|-

The generated list of every entry is on the [[Angler's Almanac]] page.

== Technical advancements ==
Most of the pack's advancement files have no display. They are invisible to players and act as event triggers, a common datapack technique. They are grouped by folder:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement}}</ref>
{{Data/Advancements/technical
|matcha:recipe_unlocks=Unlock recipes when the player obtains an item, for example logs unlock the kindling and chest recipes. The whole folder is revoked when the pack is updated.
|matcha:mechanics=Trigger mechanics: using a [[Crystal Heart|crystal heart]], [[Amnestic|amnestic]], [[Asylum Seeker|asylum application]], [[Beacon Kindling|beacon kindling]], [[Bedrock Buster|bedrock buster]], clay fetishes or the happy ghast horn; eating glow berry foods (soul sight); sleeping; summoning the Wither; hitting a [[Copper Eye|copper eye]]; getting the Wither effect; entering a village or fortress; handling Estus and intrinsic enchantments.
|matcha:fishing_sounds=Play a distinct sound for each kind of catch. See [[Fishing sounds]].
|matcha:update_old_items=Replace old copies of the sacred texts and the "Golden" music disc with current ones. See [[Updating items]].
|matcha:cooking_recipes=Unlock secret recipes (chorus mochi, gnocchi, sweet berry toast and warped stroganoff) when their recipe item is obtained.
|matcha:particle=Particles when boarding a boat, walking on sulfurous hellstone, or drinking from an Estus flask.
|matcha:remove_vanilla_items=Convert vanilla apples, sweet berries and turtle scutes, for example from other mods, into the pack's versions.
|endless_repairs:inventory_changed=Reset the repair cost of items so anvil repairs never become "Too Expensive".
|matcha:anglers_almanac=Unlock the [[#Angler's Almanac|Angler's Almanac]] tab when the player obtains the [[Angler's Almanac]].
|matcha:item_contingencies=Turn unenchanted vanilla elytra into the pack's version.
|matcha:update_vanilla_item=Turn vanilla water bottles into the pack's version.
}}

== Trivia ==
* The titles "Brilliant Bronze" and "Palatinate Perfection" keep the old names of hepatizon and shakudo. The internal IDs of the hepatizon advancements still say "bronze".
* The "Canto" titles follow ''The Divine Comedy'', and the Hell tab's root is "Through Hell". "Orpheus" refers to the musician who descended into the underworld.
* The icon of "No More Fish in the Sea" uses a model called <code>gay_fish</code>, and "A True Community" uses a heart.
* The Hepatizon Elytra's name uses the translation key <code>item.kleispack.hepatizon_elytra</code>, which is missing from the language file (only <code>item.kleispack.bronze_elytra</code> exists), so the smithed item shows its raw key in game.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_elytra.json}}</ref>
* A common criticism of the pack is that its advancements and systems are not explained enough. The developer disagreed and said they enjoyed watching players, who had no wiki at first, work the pack out "like a puzzle".<ref>{{Cite video|id=wavOi0ULYpQ|title=How Criticism changed Matcha Flavoured|quote=a big criticism is that the advancements are too confusing. that um that basically everything is too confusing that there aren't nothing is spelled out enough. Uh and I just I I'm sorry. I don't agree.}}</ref>
